Max volumetric speed kept at the printer profile's 12 mm3/s; the manufacturer's 200 mm/s (4.5 mm3/s) is a print-speed recommendation, not a limit.
Temperature set for ~250 mm/s on this printer: 235 C (first layer 220 C). Manufacturer bands: 215-225 C at 50-100 mm/s; 225-245 C at 100-200 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Product page: 215-225C @50-100, 225-245C @100-200mm/s. Hardened nozzle not mentioned by SUNLU (wiki only notes dust protection when sanding). Shore (HA/HD) 84. Wiki: fan ON, drying 50C.
